title: Correctness of the timed median of three
statement: Let $a$, $b$, $c$ be elements of a linearly ordered set. Then the value returned by the timed computation $\mathrm{median3}(a,b,c)$ is a median of $a$, $b$, and $c$: it is one of the three inputs occupying the middle position in the order, so that at least one of the remaining two values is $\le$ it and at least one is $\ge$ it.
hypotheses_covered: a, b, c are elements of a linearly ordered type
replaced:
The value returned by $\mathrm{median3}\,a\,b\,c$ is a median of $a$, $b$, $c$, in the sense that
it lies between at least one of the pairs drawn from $\{a,b,c\}$.
